subject: PO prerequisites & AP onboarding packet for NovaClinic — vendor token + tax items
body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@novaclinic.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: PO prerequisites & AP onboarding packet for NovaClinic — vendor token + tax items

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the kickoff today. Per our conversation, we want to make onboarding into NovaClinic's AP system as painless as possible. To avoid payment delays on the first invoice, could you confirm the PO prerequisites your team requires for Redwood invoices? Specifically:

- Required PO fields (PO number, billing account, line-item references)
- Any mandatory attachments (W9/W8, vendor setup form, signed MSLA)
- Preferred invoice file format (PDF vs. e-invoice XML) and where to send it
- Whether we need a vendor token or supplier ID from your portal, and the contact who can provision it

I attached our standard AP packet (NC_AP_Form.pdf) and a sample invoice. Once we have the exact field list we will map our invoice generator to ensure PO linkage and speed payment.

Action: if you can share the AP contact and a sample PO, I will route the vendor registration packet to them today.

Best,
Aditya
Aditya Rao | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: NC_AP_Form.pdf, sample_invoice_9472.xml

---

From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@novaclinic.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@novaclinic.com>
Date: 2025-10-13T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO prerequisites & AP onboarding packet for NovaClinic — vendor token + tax items

Hi Aditya,

Thanks — quick answers below. Our AP team requires:

- PO number (required) and our internal project code (optional but preferred)
- Billing legal name that matches W9/W8 (we run automated entity checks)
- Invoice must include a line-level PO reference if billing multiple workstreams
- Preferred format: PDF for initial onboarding, we can accept UBL/UBL-XML later via SFTP
- Vendor token: yes, we use a supplier portal. Please fill our Vendor Enrollment Form and send to ap@novaclinic.com; portal provisioning takes ~48 hours.

Tom is looped for vendor provisioning — he manages the supplier portal.

Can you send the completed vendor packet and a copy of your W9? Also, do you support split invoices (part PO / part non-PO)?

Regards,
Elena
Elena Novak
Head of Procurement Operations, NovaClinic
elena.novak@novaclinic.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@novaclinic.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-13T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO prerequisites & AP onboarding packet for NovaClinic — vendor token + tax items

Hi Elena / Aditya,

Thanks for the details, Elena. Quick checklist from our side so your AP has everything they need:

- Completed vendor enrollment form: I will populate the attached NC_AP_Form.pdf and return signed (will include Redwood legal name as on W9).
- Tax doc: attached W9 (w9_aditya_rao_signed.pdf) for Redwood US entity.
- Bank remit: we will include bank account name, routing, and SWIFT in the portal; please confirm EFT cutoffs if any.
- Invoice format: we will send the first invoice as a PDF and also provide the UBL XML on request.
- PO mapping: please confirm the exact JSON/XML field name for PO number, project_code, and line_item_ref so we can match them to your portal.
- Split invoices: we support split invoices (PO-backed amounts and non-PO professional services) but need a clear PO mapping per line to prevent automatic rejects.

Attaching: NC_AP_Form.pdf (populated draft), w9_aditya_rao_signed.pdf, sample_invoice_9472.xml

--
Kimberly Park
Sr. Finance Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: NC_AP_Form.pdf, w9_aditya_rao_signed.pdf, sample_invoice_9472.xml

---

From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@novaclinic.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Elena Novak <elena.novak@novaclinic.com>
Date: 2025-10-14T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO prerequisites & AP onboarding packet for NovaClinic — vendor token + tax items

Kimberly / Aditya,

I got the draft. Portal provisioning: please submit the completed form to ap@novaclinic.com and include the business contact who will manage payments (name + email). Our supplier portal creates a vendor token within 48 hrs after we verify the W9 and bank remit. EFT cutoffs are 4pm PT on Thursdays for weekly runs; same-day is not available.

Also: NovaClinic offers an early-pay program (2% discount for net-10) for approved vendors. That requires signing the EarlyPay addendum; if you'd like to opt in, we'll route the addendum when we provision the vendor record.

Tom
Supplier Onboarding Lead, NovaClinic

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wu <tom.wu@novaclinic.com>, Elena Novak <elena.novak@novaclinic.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-15T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO prerequisites & AP onboarding packet for NovaClinic — vendor token + tax items

Tom / Elena — thanks, this is clear and very helpful.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) We will complete and submit the vendor enrollment form to ap@novaclinic.com by EOD tomorrow.
2) Kimberly attached the W9 and a populated AP packet — I will include our primary payments contact (Neha) in the submission.
3) Please provision the vendor token and share the supplier ID so we can embed it into our invoice metadata.
4) Regarding EarlyPay: we are interested in the program for this engagement; please include the EarlyPay addendum in the provisioning package.

Action items for Redwood: Kimberly — I asked Neha to confirm bank remit details and to attach a signed copy of the W9.

Thanks everyone — aiming for first invoice to land with a PO reference week of 10/20.

Best,
Aditya

Redwood Internal Tracking: DEAL-9472 | Owner: aditya.rao
